effects.printed_clause: If controlling no monsters or only "Arckcestial" monsters: Special Summon from hand; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Hand ignition checks no non-Arckcestial controlled monster and an open zone, then summons self under id HOPT.

effects.printed_clause: If sent as Synchro Material for a LIGHT monster: target another Level 4 or lower "Arckcestial" in GY and Special Summon it; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed material trigger validates Synchro/LIGHT reason, targets a legal Necrovalley candidate, and revives it under separate HOPT.

coverage_override.reason: The hand self-Summon condition and HOPT form one effect; the LIGHT Synchro-material revival trigger and its separate HOPT form the other. The heuristic double-counted conditional phrasing.
